title: How to Train Your Little Dragon: Teaching a Small Language Model to Construct and Refine GPU Optimization Scripts
abstract: arXiv:2610.20980v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Compiler transformations interact, making GPU kernel optimization a search for combinations that preserve the computation while improving performance. We introduce HOW TO TRAIN YOUR LITTLE DRAGON, a training method that teaches a small language model both to construct complete optimization scripts and to improve existing ones. Instead of ranking candidates or generating kernel code, our model generates optimization scripts. We devise a compact, lossless representation whose deterministic decoding reconstructs the exact compiler trace, preserving its transformation parameters and dependencies. We use a compiler framework TVM MetaSchedule to build training data on 54,116 distinct workloads, and construct 108,594 examples in two training sets: 60,236 teach the model to generate an optimized script from an unoptimized kernel, while 48,358 teach it to produce a better script given the kernel and a somewhat optimized script. translated_title: 如何训练你的小龙：教会小型语言模型构建与改进GPU优化脚本
translated_abstract: 编译器变换之间存在相互作用，这使得GPU内核优化成为一项搜索任务——需要找到既能保持计算语义又能提升性能的变换组合。我们提出了"如何训练你的小龙"（HOW TO TRAIN YOUR LITTLE DRAGON），这是一种训练方法，教会小型语言模型既能构建完整的优化脚本，又能改进已有的优化脚本。我们的模型不对候选方案进行排序，也不生成内核代码，而是直接生成优化脚本。我们设计了一种紧凑的无损表示，通过其确定性解码能够精确重建编译器轨迹，完整保留其中的变换参数和依赖关系。我们利用编译器框架TVM MetaSchedule在54,116个不同的工作负载上构建训练数据，并在两个训练集中共构建了108,594个样本：其中60,236个样本教会模型从未优化的内核生成优化脚本，另外48,358个样本教会模型在给定内核和一个已有一定优化的脚本的情况下产出更好的脚本。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种训练小型语言模型的方法，使其学会生成和迭代改进GPU内核优化脚本，通过设计紧凑无损的脚本表示以及基于TVM MetaSchedule构建的十余万条训练样本，实现了自动化的内核优化脚本构造与精炼。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a training method that teaches a small language model to both construct and refine GPU optimization scripts, leveraging a compact lossless script representation and over 108,000 training examples built with TVM MetaSchedule to enable automated and iterative kernel optimization.
